articles.title: Injuries, trades, fire trucks: How the Giants turned over an entire roster (almost) in 2026
articles.description: To understand just how lousy the Giants' season has been, take a look at what happened to the players who were on the roster in late-March.

articles.title: Giants doomed at Dodger Stadium by another disastrous dugout decision
articles.description: The Giants went to a lefty reliever Saturday who had allowed four homers in an inning the previous night in a tie game. It didn't go well.

articles.title: Giants’ Rafael Devers has been on a tear and he’s been headed for season-ending surgery all along
articles.description: The Giants placed Devers on the 60-day injured list and selected outfielder Scott Bandura from Triple-A Sacramento.

articles.title: Giants broadcaster Mike Krukow raves about Twins’ Brooks Lee. He’s known him since birth
articles.description: Krukow, whose connection with Lee's family dates back generations, praised Lee on the Giants' broadcast after he hit a solo home run Monday.

articles.title: Giants conclude miserable season on the road by getting swept at Dodger Stadium
articles.description: The Giants finished with a winning mark on only one road trip this season — a three-game visit to San Diego in March.

articles.title: How the Giants who were dealt away at the trade deadline are doing
articles.description: The Giants have managed to be an entertaining club since the deadline. Not everyone they dealt has enjoyed the same outcome.
